source: v1 sem o aviso gravado na tela.
description_pt: Vertical 9:16, Bia aparece segurando o produto, sem fala, três cenas, ~15 s finais. Experimental: consistência do rosto não garantida.

scenes.title: Apresentadora com o produto
scenes.objective: Bia apresenta o produto segurando-o na altura do peito, olhando para a câmera.
scenes.framing: Plano médio vertical, da cintura para cima; produto inteiro visível.
scenes.motion: Bia levanta levemente o produto e sorri; sem fala.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create a vertical 9:16 photograph to be used as the first frame of a product video.

REFERENCES: the official product photos exclusively define the product. The presenter reference image defines the woman's identity.

$product_block

$hands
She holds the product with both hands at chest height, fully visible, with a warm natural smile and eyes to the camera. Her mouth is closed or gently smiling; she is not speaking.

$environment
$lighting

COMPOSITION: medium shot from the waist up, product clearly visible and not covering her face.

Still image. $camera
$negative Do not beautify or modify the product.
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate the attached image into a vertical 9:16 video. Preserve exactly the woman's face, hair, glasses, clothing, the product, setting and light.

She lifts the product a few centimeters, turning it slightly to show the front, smiles and keeps eye contact with the camera. She does not speak; lips stay closed or in a smile. Fixed camera.

The product stays rigid and identical. No new objects, speech, narration, music or on-screen text. Silent.
approval_criteria: Rosto, cabelo e óculos compatíveis com a referência da Bia

scenes.title: Detalhes nas mãos
scenes.objective: Plano próximo das mãos da Bia mostrando os detalhes visíveis do produto.
scenes.framing: Plano próximo das mãos e do produto.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create a second vertical 9:16 photograph from the same session. Use the scene-1 image for continuity of hands, clothing, setting and light; the official photos define the product.

Close-up of her hands holding the product, highlighting the visible details exactly as in the references. Her face is out of frame.

$product_block

Sharp product and fingers, natural reflections. $camera
$negative
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate this photograph into a vertical 9:16 video. The hands gently rotate the product about 10 degrees and return. Fixed close-up camera.

Do not deform the product or the fingers. No new objects, speech, music or text. Silent.
approval_criteria: Mesmas mãos e roupa da cena 1

scenes.title: Fechamento
scenes.objective: Bia coloca o produto na superfície e sorri para a câmera.
scenes.framing: Plano médio com o produto em primeiro plano.
scenes.motion: Bia apoia o produto e sorri; câmera fixa.
scenes.image_prompt:
Create the third vertical 9:16 photograph of the same session. Use the scene-1 image for her identity, clothing, setting and light; the official photos define the product.

The product stands on a surface in the foreground, whole and in focus; she is slightly behind it, smiling at the camera, not speaking.

$product_block

$hands

$environment
$lighting

$camera
$negative
scenes.animation_prompt:
Animate the starting image into a vertical 9:16 video. Preserve her face, the product, setting and light. She gives a small nod and smile to the camera without speaking. The product stays still.

No speech, music, text or new objects. Silent.
approval_criteria: Rosto consistente com as cenas anteriores
